info.name: BookVerse API
info.description:
End-to-end collection for the BookVerse e-book REST API.

## How to use

1. Import this collection + one of the environments (`bookverse.local.postman_environment.json` or `bookverse.prod.postman_environment.json`).
2. Select the environment so `{{baseUrl}}` resolves.
3. Start the app (`mvn spring-boot:run` — H2 in-memory DB, seeded with ~500 books).
4. Run the collection: **BookVerse API → ▸ ▸ Run collection**.

## Notes

- Every folder runs in dependency order (seed a book, then read/update/delete it). Run the whole collection, or run each folder in order.
- Tests validate HTTP status + JSON schema/values and capture ids via `pm.collectionVariables` (see Test Results → collectionVariables after the run).
- Bulk import tests use the files under `postman/` (relative to your working dir): `sample-books.csv`, `sample-books-dup.csv`, `sample-books-bad.csv`.
- Cover-upload tests use `sample-cover.png` (valid PNG) and `sample-unsupported.txt` (invalid).

## API contract

PUT `/api/books/{id}` is **multipart** (a JSON part named `book`, optional `cover` part).
GET `/api/books/categories` and `/api/books/years` expose filter metadata.
PUT `/api/books/{id}/cover` replaces an existing cover.
Error responses use a structured `code` field (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, `BOOK_NOT_FOUND`, `ISBN_ALREADY_EXISTS`, `INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT`, `MISSING_PART`, `BAD_REQUEST`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`).
